pages.text: Look at a slot and right-click with a book to fill it. Sneak-right-click the slot to eject its book. Right-click empty-handed without sneaking to open a menu with all sixteen slots.
This is the oak version. Other woods use their own plank and slab recipes.

pages.title: Books and Redstone
pages.text: Each occupied slot adds one eighth of a vanilla bookshelf’s enchanting power. With redstone books enabled, a redstone book powers every side except the opening. The creative-only bookcase fills itself with generated books on placement.
